verdict.rationale: QuickBooks ships 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that lets users create invoices, run payroll, generate reports, and ask natural-language questions like 'What's driving my profit?'—directly matching the story of natural-language operation. This is corroborated by an official MCP server exposing 145 tools for agentic/API-driven natural-language workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the NL chat reliably executes complex commands, and community evidence is silent on this specific feature (only general product complaints exist).
